name: mandible-cpu-game
note: the self-playing cart: CPU Hard (Ivory) against CPU Normal (Ebony), every move entered by pressing the pad's actions; a full game ends with a legal result inside the frame budget and both GPU hosts reach the same state hash. Control: the same run stopped at frame 1000, mid-game (a finished game no longer changes in its last frame, so a run one frame short matched it)

name: mandible-idle-seat
note: a CPU (Normal) on Ivory and a person on Ebony who never touches the pad (the how-to-play card still open): the CPU plays its opening under the card and the game waits for the person. Control: the person takes Ivory instead, the idle seat moves first, and nothing is played (ply 0)

name: mandible-newcomer
note: a newcomer on Ivory's pad against CPU Easy, using only what the screen offers (MANDIBLE_NEWCOMER): it closes the card, takes a lit piece and puts it on a lit space, preferring a kind of move it has not made yet (placing from the hand, stepping on the table, climbing onto a stack; a pass comes only when nothing else is legal, and tests/mandible-moves.mjs drives that one). A full game ends inside the frame budget with all three kinds made. Control: the same player lost (MANDIBLE_NEWCOMER=lost), who closes the card and walks the cursor but never takes a piece, so no game is played
